title: agents_Inc: A Model Ladder for Delegating and Verifying Work Across AI Agents
description:
agents_Inc is a Python package that hands work from one AI coding session to other models and checks the result before anyone accepts it. It pools Claude, Codex, Gemini, Mistral and OpenRouter capacity that you already pay for, with no added API spend. A four-rung ladder (Executive, Orchestrator, Workhorse, Grunt) sets who manages whom. A model never grades its own work: each result passes deterministic checks, then a reviewer, and the decision goes into an append-only ledger. The main entry point is the agents-inc command (dispatch, doctor, repair, ledger). Install with pip install agents-inc, then run agents-inc install; the import name is agents_inc. The project is experimental, and its savings are not yet measured.

This release (0.4.0)

Added

  • Delegates see their own permissions (#54). Each Claude delegate prompt now lists the tools and commands the run allows and denies. A blocked command is reported as a missing grant, not as a policy refusal. In a live check, a delegate allowed to view issue 54 only viewed it, ran its tests, and stopped at the comment step; nothing was posted.
  • Leads can launch Workers. Claude delegates (fable, opus, sonnet) and Codex delegates (astra, sol, terra) start lower-rung Workers through a broker that checks the parent run's token, roster, fan-out limits and tool grants (D57, D60, #68).
  • Agent gate (D61). An optional hook can block Claude Agent calls that bypass agents-inc. The default mode is advisory and blocks nothing.
  • Dispatch fails loud (D64). A red run names its cause, such as blocked, timeout or launch-failed. agents-inc dispatch exits 69 when blocked and 75 on a quota pause, and the scope check reads a snapshot copy kept outside the delegate's reach.
  • Sandboxed callers stop early (D65, #94). A dispatch started inside the Claude Code or Codex sandbox exits 69 before any delegate starts and says how to rerun it.

Changed

  • Leads sub-delegate only through agents-inc dispatch (D59).
  • Codex delegates have no network unless a dispatch opts in; agents-inc doctor says so (#66).

Fixed

  • pre_dispatch_snapshot.py verify --allow a b c accepts several paths after one flag; it exited with a usage error before.
  • A delegate that stops on a usage limit ends with quota-paused, which counts as one failed attempt.
  • agents-inc dispatch --resume accepts a run-directory path as well as a run id.
  • Workers launched by the broker can run shell commands again: they no longer nest a second sandbox inside the broker's (#94).
  • The credential screen no longer refuses requests that mention "tokens" or skill paths under ~/.claude/skills/, and a refusal names the slot and the text it matched (#95).

Roadmap at 0.4.0

  • Now: measure the token cost of delegation against doing the work in one session.
  • Next: let a Worker launched by a broker lead its own Workers (#73).
  • Later: route work by data classification, so unpublished work reaches only approved providers (#19).
